subject: Meet Forge — Wren's code drafter (call him when you need a patch)
body:
Acer — Ross said you need to know about Forge and Sage. Here's Forge.

WHO: Forge is Wren's code-drafter. Terse, all implementation, no preamble. Outputs the patch/function/file body — no essays. GDScript and Python first-class.

WHERE: tools/qsb_wren_team.py --worker forge --task "..."
MODEL: codellama:13b (primary, currently pulling), fallback list resolves in order: codellama:13b → qwen2.5-coder → hermes3:8b → qwen2.5:7b → iquest-coder-cpu:40b. Today Forge is running on hermes3:8b (3.79s per task) because codellama isn't pulled yet.

HOW YOU CALL HIM from your Windows box (curl works fine on PowerShell 7+):
  ssh ross@192.168.0.20 "python3 /vaults/nvme0/qsb_tower_v1/tools/qsb_wren_team.py --worker forge --task 'YOUR TASK'"

Or hit HQ from your side if you have shell access. He answers in one turn, drops the code, done.

LIVE PROOF (Ross saw this transcript 2026-07-03T05:31Z):
  Task: "6 lines of Python: def utc_iso() returning current UTC time as ISO 8601 string ending in Z. No preamble."
  Forge (wall 3.79s, model=hermes3:8b):
      def utc_iso():
          '''Return current UTC time as ISO 8601 string ending in Z.'''
          return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() + 'Z'

TEAMMATES also callable via qsb_wren_team.py:
  pip (llama3.2 assistant, summaries)
  mira (llama2:13b reviewer, second-opinion)
  bram (mistral:7b triage)
  cass (neural-chat:7b scribe, briefings for Ross)

WHEN TO CALL FORGE: any code task Wren specced. Wren SPECS, Forge CODES. That's the working pattern in this tower.

WHEN NOT: real-money paths, vault, CLAUDE.md — those are SAFETY_DENY regardless of who's calling.

Real-money gates LOCKED FALSE unchanged.
